Package org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.templates

Class IndexerConstants

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.templates.IndexerConstants
public class IndexerConstants extends Object
Constants and sensor thresholds for the IndexerSubsystem. Overview: Defines hardware configuration names, physical distance thresholds, ambient light triggers, and capacity limits for the 3-sensor multi-zone piece tracking system. Hardware Configuration: - Entry Distance Sensor: "sensorEntry" (I2C Bus) - Middle REV Color/Light Sensor: "middleSensor" (I2C Bus) - Exit Distance/Color Sensor: "sensor_color_distance" (I2C Bus)
